enforcing_note: Report-only while the C++ number climbs. Flip to true once plugins/* clears the floor -- the tests below already compute the verdict, this only decides whether a shortfall fails ctest or prints. Added 2026-09-29.

exempt.plugins/trance-gate: What is left in TranceGate.cpp after Wire.cpp was lifted out is calls into iPlug2 and into the engine -- GetParam, SendParameterValueFromUI, EditorResizeFromUI, tg_core_process_f32_split. A test that stubbed those would be asserting on the stub. tg_au drives the real parameter API against a real host and tg_render_ab hashes the real audio path; those two are what cover this file, and neither can be counted here because both run against a bundle rather than an instrumented object.
exempt.plugins/spectrogram: The same as the Trance Gate's, one file smaller: Spectrogram.cpp is ProcessBlock, OnIdle and OnReset around spectro_* calls, with the encoders now in Wire.cpp where spectro_wire reaches them. It declares no parameters at all, so there is no mapping layer here to test either.
exempt.plugins/side-chain: The same as the other two shells': what is left in SideChain.cpp after Wire.cpp was lifted out is calls into iPlug2 and into the engine -- GetParam, IsChannelConnected, SendParameterValueFromUI, sc_core_process_f32_split_tap. A test that stubbed those would be asserting on the stub. auval drives the real AU through a real host and sc_wire reaches every piece of arithmetic that was lifted out; neither can be counted here, because one runs against a bundle and the other against a two-file binary that links no engine.
exempt.modules/side-chain: An aarch64 Linux cross-build produced in a container by package.sh, so nothing in it is compiled or loaded by the instrumented build -- it can have no coverage number rather than a low one. Its DSP is sc-core, which IS counted, and unlike the Trance Gate's module there is no ui_chain.js here: the Move draws its own knob grid from chain_params, so the gap this exemption covers is smaller by 1315 lines.
exempt.modules/trance-gate: The Schwung module is an aarch64 Linux cross-build produced in a container by package.sh, so nothing in it is compiled or loaded by the instrumented build and it can have no coverage number rather than a low one. Its DSP is tg-core, which IS counted. This exemption also covers ui_chain.js, 1315 lines that run on the Move hardware and are reachable only through the Schwung host -- that is a real gap and this is not a claim otherwise, it is a statement that this build cannot measure it.
